title: Seal derived-output collection views against backing-store mutation
description:
Council multi-round audit found two read-only-looking APIs that still expose mutable backing collections through interface covariance/casts: GeneratedCreature.Geometry returns its private List as IReadOnlyList, and CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer.Bones returns its backing Transform[] as IReadOnlyList. Both can be mutated by downcasting despite documentation describing consumer read-only behavior.

Scope: return actual read-only wrappers/snapshots, add regression coverage for cast-based mutation, preserve ordering and object identity, and keep runtime/editor ownership unchanged. Coordinate with TSK-0125 (GeneratedCreature) and TSK-0132 (skinned adapter).

Validation gate: runtime build plus focused ownership tests; Unity execution required before closure.
